source_locator: Games Monitor '12, printed p. 28 / PDF p. 28, Appendix 1 Methodological accountability, Banen; corroborating headline printed p. 7 / PDF p. 7
definition: Dutch establishments of companies and self-employed persons whose core activity is electronic-game development, production, publishing, facilitation or distribution; includes applied and entertainment games and qualifying specialist services; excludes clients, education, government, retail, physical games and online gambling. LISA jobs are paid jobs of at least 12 hours per week, supplemented by website/survey estimates. Foreign establishments are excluded.
trend_review: Isolated legacy and interim estimates. Appendix Banen explicitly dates 3,000 jobs to 2011, supplemented by summer-2012 survey/web data and imputation; no precise synchronized census date. 2020 is approximately 4,000 from a limited interim survey.

period: 2020 interim estimate; exact stock date unspecified
source_locator: Games Monitor 2020 Update - COVID Impact, printed/PDF p. 6, Revenue Development / Employee Development; corroborating printed/PDF p. 8, Summary
definition: Limited-survey interim estimate for the Dutch video-game industry using the same criteria as earlier Games Monitor editions. The report says the database was updated and a November 2020 survey sent to around 500 people, with a little over 100 responses; websites, LinkedIn profiles and directory updates support the approximate employee total. Includes applied and entertainment companies, but the report does not publish a full headcount methodology or an exact all-worker census.
